en.title: Resident Evil Creator Shinji Mikami Joins AIAS Hall of Fame
en.summary: The legendary creator behind survival horror classics is being honored for his monumental contributions to the gaming industry. Shinji Mikami will be inducted into the Academy of Interactive Arts & Sciences Hall of Fame at the upcoming DICE Awards.
en.body:
The Academy of Interactive Arts & Sciences (AIAS) is set to celebrate a true titan of the video game industry, **Shinji Mikami**, with his induction into the AIAS Hall of Fame. This prestigious honor will be bestowed upon the visionary developer at the 30th DICE Awards ceremony, scheduled for February 18, 2026. Known globally as the mastermind behind the iconic **Resident Evil** franchise, Mikami's career spans over three decades of groundbreaking work, leaving an indelible mark on game design and horror storytelling.

Mikami's journey in the industry began at Capcom in 1990, where he quickly rose to prominence. His directorial debut with the original **Resident Evil** in 1996 redefined the survival horror genre, introducing a generation of players to tense exploration, resource management, and terrifying encounters. He continued to steer the series through its formative years, and his influence extended to other notable titles like **Dino Crisis**. Beyond his work at Capcom, Mikami founded Tango Gameworks, where he served as a producer and creative director, contributing to titles such as **The Evil Within** series, further cementing his reputation for delivering high-quality, atmospheric experiences.

## A Legacy of Fear and Innovation

The induction recognizes Mikami's profound impact not just on horror games, but on interactive entertainment as a whole. His keen eye for atmosphere, innovative gameplay mechanics, and dedication to pushing creative boundaries have inspired a generation of developers and captivated millions of players worldwide. The AIAS Hall of Fame celebrates individuals who have made significant contributions to the evolution of video games, and **Shinji Mikami** is undoubtedly a deserving recipient. His work has not only terrified but also thrilled players, proving that intelligent design and compelling narratives can create truly unforgettable gaming moments.

## Honored by Peers and Legends

Adding a personal touch to the ceremony, **Goichi Suda**, also known as Suda 51 and CEO of Grasshopper Manufacture, will be presenting the award to Mikami. Suda and Mikami share a history of creative collaboration, having worked together on cult classics like **Killer7** and **Shadows of the Damned**. This reunion of creative minds at such a significant event underscores the respect and camaraderie within the industry, highlighting the shared passion that drives its greatest talents.

## What's Next

The 30th DICE Awards ceremony, where **Shinji Mikami** will officially be inducted into the AIAS Hall of Fame, is set to take place on February 18, 2026. Fans will undoubtedly be eager to witness this well-deserved tribute to a true master of interactive horror.
